newsitem.title: UK: UK road fuel gas tax cuts excellent news - Brit Gas.
newsitem.headline: UK road fuel gas tax cuts excellent news - Brit Gas.

text.p: The decision by U.K. Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke to cut duty on road fuel gases by 25 percent from today is "excellent news," said Tom Gorman, head of British Gas Natural Gas Vehicles.
"This comes on top of a 15 percent cut last year and on top of a freezing of duties the year before. It shows the government is is recognising the potential benefits of gas as a transport fuel.

"As far as we are concerned it's excellent news. The pump has been primed for three budgets in a row and now the burden switches to commnercial fleet operators to respond to the government's challenge by switching fuels."
Gorman said the duty cut would have the effect of lowering the pump price of natural gas to around 44 pence a litre of gasoline equivalent, down from a current price of 48.5 pence.
The duty has been reduced from 28 pence per kg to 21 pence, although Gorman said he had been hoping for a cut to 10 pence.
